name: ◁═════[‐ COMPLEX GAMING ‐]═════▷
description:
Complex Gaming is one of the best Minecraft Bedrock and MCPE servers, a friendly crossplay network where Bedrock (MCPE) and Java players play together on Skyblock, Survival SMP, Prison and Factions, with a real player-driven economy. Running since 2016 with 15 million+ players. Free to play, not pay to win.

Bedrock Server IP: mps.mc-complex.com

Bedrock Server Port: 19132

Java Server IP: mps.mc-complex.com

Note: mc-complex.com is our website, not a server IP.

Play on mobile (MCPE), Windows, Xbox, PlayStation and Switch with the latest Bedrock version. No mods or add-ons needed. Console join guide: https://www.mc-complex.com/forums/vanilla/wiki-page/83/

Why Bedrock players stay:

- 2,000+ players online every day across the whole network, 320,000+ Discord members, friendly community and helpful staff

- Play with friends on any device: full crossplay with Java, /friends and /party

- Dungeons on Skyblock, Survival and Prison, open to Bedrock and Java players

- Economy: auction house, player chest shops, /jobs, player warps and /baltop

- Free store credit: earn GC in-game. The top 12 on /leaderboard win GC every week, team leaderboards pay up to 500 GC, plus giveaways

Bedrock Skyblock Server (MCPE): 1,000+ players online at its all-time peak, on mobile, Xbox, PlayStation, Switch and Windows. Seasonal island resets give everyone a fresh start. Build your island with up to 10 friends, grind with custom enchants, runes and minions, sell in chest shops and the auction house, and take on Dungeons, the Pharaoh's Tomb and the Pharaoh's Realm. The top islands win up to 500 GC every month. Guide: https://www.mc-complex.com/forums/vanilla/wiki-page/17/

Bedrock Survival Server (SMP): a beginner-friendly public SMP for Bedrock and Java. PvP is only on in set areas, so you can build in peace with land claims, guilds that build towns together, jobs, chest shops, player warps, weekly Guild Top and the Dragon's Dojo. Guide: https://www.mc-complex.com/forums/vanilla/wiki-page
